title: r2 minor SA: recovery-family gloss excludes reconcile-toward-artifact
description: Evidence: composition-scope-and-actions.md:60 glosses recovery as 'the state artifact itself needs repair', but reconcile-toward-artifact (:42) repairs the tracker TOWARD the authoritative artifact — the artifact is precisely what does not need repair. Disposition: broaden the gloss to cover reconciling external corroboration toward the artifact. Owner: data-engineer. Validator: solution-architect.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: FIX LANDED (commit 026564ee): the recovery-family gloss now reads 'the state artifact needs repair, or its corroboration needs reconciling toward it', naming reconcile-toward-artifact's direction explicitly. Terminal round re-verifies (validator: solution-architect).
